summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist, which follows the six-step workflow and imports only os and json. Exported it from monai/data/__init__.py with an explicit import. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection after the Utilities block in docs/source/data.rst with one autofunction entry. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist, covering test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, and test_seg_no_labels. Each test removes its temp directory in a finally block. Choices I made: the loader is unannotated because typing is off-limits; a non-list key value raises ValueError; invalid JSON is re-raised as ValueError naming the file. Not verified: I did not run the tests, Black, or flake8, so formatting and test results are unconfirmed. Nothing is committed.
